notes.goal: Build an email assistant agent using AISuite that can process natural language instructions and orchestrate multiple tools to manage a simulated inbox.

steps.title: Initialize Environment and Client
steps.what_happens: Loads environment variables and initializes the AISuite client to connect with language models.

steps.title: Test Simulated Email Service
steps.what_happens: Runs quick wrapper functions to confirm the backend API endpoints for sending, reading, and deleting emails work correctly.

steps.title: Test Email Tool Layer
steps.what_happens: Exercises Python functions that wrap the API routes, ensuring the tool layer can successfully interact with the inbox.

steps.title: Prepare Agent Prompt
steps.what_happens: Defines a helper function to wrap user requests in system instructions that give the agent its persona and tool permissions.

steps.title: Run Multi-Step Email Workflow
steps.what_happens: Instructs the agent to check unread emails from the boss, mark them as read, and send a polite follow-up automatically.

steps.title: Handle Missing Tools
steps.what_happens: Demonstrates that an agent cannot execute a task if the required tool is omitted from its available tool set.

steps.title: Execute Targeted Actions with Delete Tool
steps.what_happens: Adds the delete tool to the agent's toolkit so it can successfully locate and delete specific emails like the Happy Hour message.

notes.results: The lab ran successfully with zero cell errors. The LLM agent correctly chained multi-step tool calls to search for emails, mark them as read, send replies, and delete messages based entirely on natural language prompts.
try_next: Write a new tool function that filters emails by a custom date range and register it with the agent.
Change the user prompt to ask the agent to search for and summarize all emails from a specific sender.
Remove the send_email tool from the tool list and observe how the agent handles a request that requires replying.
